data.summary: Attempt 2 is green. The factory-executed `npm test` exited 0 with 67 tests, 67 passing, 0 failing and 0 skipped, and the factory-executed `npm run build` exited 0. I could not run commands myself, so the two executions are the factory's evidence. Static inspection confirms the privacy masking is money-only, the chart modals use `withChartDefaults` (zoom forced on), no light-only colour classes remain, and Home renders skeletons while loading. Browser-level checks (theme persistence without flash, the mobile menu, modal Escape/backdrop behaviour) were not executed.

e2eChecks.name: No formatPercentForPrivacy references remain
e2eChecks.actual: no matches; currencyAdapter.js exports formatPercent (no privacy argument)

e2eChecks.name: Summary profit percentage is not masked
e2eChecks.expected: profit uses formatPercent, money cards use formatValueForPrivacy

e2eChecks.name: Chart zoom enabled on all three graph modals
e2eChecks.actual: InvestmentGraphModal.tsx (3 charts), ForecastGraphModal.jsx and CombinedForecastGraphModal.jsx all wrap options in withChartDefaults; getZoomOptions sets zoom.enabled true and toolbar.show true, overriding the old zoom.enabled false

e2eChecks.name: No light-only colour classes remain
e2eChecks.request: ripgrep bg-/text-/border- gray|slate|stone|zinc|white at -50/-100/-200 over ui/src excluding tests

e2eChecks.name: Header mobile menu aria-expanded toggling
e2eChecks.actual: Header.astro:77-80 toggles aria-expanded and the menu class

e2eChecks.name: Theme persistence and no-flash
e2eChecks.request: static read of Layout.astro and ThemeToggle.jsx
e2eChecks.expected: inline pre-paint script reads localStorage and toggles html.dark; toggle persists
e2eChecks.actual: Layout.astro:20-24 pre-paint script toggles dark class; ThemeToggle calls applyTheme with localStorage. Not executed in a browser.

evidence: The currencyAdapter test asserting that percentages are masked was removed, but it encoded the old behaviour the task explicitly asks to drop; the replacement tests still assert real percentage formatting and money masking.
No test was skipped, disabled or loosened in the diff. chartTheme.test.js and the new theme tests add coverage.

data.recommendation: Before merge, run the dev server and check in a browser: toggle theme and reload (no flash), open and close each modal with Escape and backdrop click, and confirm zoom and pan on /investment?id=4. Optionally mask the CreateEntryModal preview money, as noted in the developer follow-ups. The acceptance criterion 'no chart component modified except the theme utility' conflicts with the task's own zoom/theme requirements and should be clarified in the PR description.
